## Scope and verification

- Change, exact tested SHA, commands / CI:
- NOT_RUN / limitations:
- Compatibility / migration:

## SDK boundary review

Apply [the canonical policy](../docs/design/sdk-boundary.md). For SDK-1 through
SDK-6 record PASS / FAIL / N/A and evidence (N/A requires a reason). Confirm these
in independent review; do not mark a candidate complete while evidence is missing.
